list.name: check
list.label: Check
list.query: All : all, Ready · dep. not declared : ready_undeclared, Ready · may be claimed : ready_claimable, Refinement · not reviewed : refinement_unreviewed, Board Done · issue open : done_open

panels.title: Ready · dep. not declared
panels.description: Ready, and an open blocked-by issue is not named in a Start after line of a readiness comment. The runner could claim it too early. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="ready_undeclared"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

panels.title: Ready · may be claimed
panels.description: Ready, and the runner selector would offer it as a claim now. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="ready_claimable"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

panels.title: Refinement · not reviewed
panels.description: Refinement, and no approved body review matches the current body. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="refinement_unreviewed"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

panels.title: Board Done · issue open
panels.description: Board Status is Done but the issue is still open. Click to show these tickets in the table.

targets.expr: ((epic_ticket_check_count{check="done_open"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)) or on() vector(-1))

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: Tickets in Backlog now; the change is against 7 days ago. Unknown while the board was not read in the last 5 min.

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Backlog"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Backlog"} @ end())

panels.title: Refinement
panels.description: Tickets in Refinement now; the change is against 7 days ago. Unknown while the board was not read in the last 5 min.

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Refinement"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Refinement"} @ end())

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Ready"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Ready"} @ end())

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="In review"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="In review"} @ end())

targets.expr: epic_tickets_by_status{status="Done"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1) and on() (last_over_time((time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds)[1m:] @ end()) < 300) and on() ((epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} @ end()) == 1) and on() (epic_tickets_by_status{status="Done"} @ end())

panels.title: Tickets per status
panels.description: Task and Subtask tickets per board status. Gaps: the collector did not see the board then.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (epic_tickets_by_status) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Tickets · $check
panels.description: Choose a check with a tile or the Check picker; All shows every ticket: not Done, plus Done in the last 7 days or still open.

targets.expr: label_replace(((epic_ticket_info and on(issue) (epic_ticket_check_member and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", ""))) or (epic_ticket_info and on() (label_replace(vector(1), "check", "$check", "", "") and on(check) label_replace(vector(1), "check", "all", "", "")))) and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1), "pr_url", "https://github.com/phaabe/live.moafunk.de/pull/$1", "pr", "(.+)")
epic_ticket_info{status="Backlog"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="Refinement"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="Ready"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="In progress"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
epic_ticket_info{status="In review"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)

panels.title: Done
panels.description: Done: still-open issues first, then the newest closed.

targets.expr: epic_ticket_info{status="Done"} and on() (time() - epic_ticket_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 300) and on() (epic_ticket_source_ok{source="board"} == 1)
